scope: Unfenced gas allocation panel SQL before scoped materialization; regression oracle only.

panels.6: SELECT l2.chain_instance_id::text AS l2_context,l2.rollup_id::text,r.allocation_state,count(*) AS posting_calls,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS incomplete_receipts,trim_scale((sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)) * 0.000000001)::text AS known_posting_cost_gwei FROM eez.posting_allocation_status r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.l2_chain_id WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY l2.chain_instance_id,l2.rollup_id,r.allocation_state ORDER BY l2.chain_instance_id,r.allocation_state
panels.9: SELECT to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) AS time,'0x'||encode(r.post_hash,'hex') AS posting_transaction,'0x'||(r.source->>'transaction_hash') AS source_transaction,r.source->>'direction' AS direction,r.source->>'chain_id' AS source_chain_id,r.success AS post_success,r.member_count,r.allocation_rule,r.evidence_class,trim_scale((r.allocated_execution_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS estimated_execution_gwei,trim_scale((r.allocated_blob_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS estimated_blob_gwei,trim_scale((r.allocated_execution_paid+r.allocated_blob_paid) * 0.000000001)::text AS estimated_total_gwei FROM eez.source_posting_allocations r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c ON c.chain_instance_id=r.l1_chain_id JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.l2_chain_id WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR r.source->>'transaction_hash'=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x','')) OR encode(r.post_hash,'hex')=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x',''))) ORDER BY r.timestamp_seconds DESC,r.post_hash,r.allocation_position LIMIT 200
